name: Amanatides–Woo grid traversal
aliases: Line walk traversal on extended grid lines
definition: An algorithm to traverse grid cells intersected by a line segment defined by two points, calling a visitor function for each cell.
summary: Amanatides–Woo grid traversal efficiently determines the sequence of axis-aligned grid cells crossed by a ray or segment, which is a fundamental step in volume rendering and ray tracing.
